title: [RC2] NSClientV3 FullSync only gets 2 days of TDD.
body:
Fresh install of AAPS 3.2, NSClientV3, all checkboxes to 'download data from NS', made Full sync. Loaded BG data, treatments, etc, but statistics shows only 2 days of TDD. So DynISF does not work correctly right from start and needs another 5 days to fill the required tdd7 data. While it exists in NS and simply must be downloaded on full sync.
History browser shows BG values, TT changes, notes and sensor change/cannula replacement events for these days, but not bolus/carbs treatments.

@MilosKozak these issues can be related https://github.com/nightscout/cgm-remote-monitor/issues/8149 and https://github.com/nightscout/cgm-remote-monitor/issues/8151
I see many HTTP500 errors during Full sync because NSClientv3 calls treatments/history without `limit` argument

Seems that I've found the reason.
This request returns ONLY TempBasals and TempTargets
api/v3/treatments?sort=date&**created_at**$gt=2023-10-21T04:28:26.411Z&limit=500

This requests returns Boluses
api/v3/treatments?sort=date&**date**$gt=2023-10-21T04:28:26.411Z&limit=500

Seems to be related to how treatments are sent to NS.
